messages:
nina: Hi all, quick Day 1 ask. MDM installer fails with 'Certificate not trusted' during enrollment on my personal Mac. Also curious if FileVault is strictly required for BYOD if I only access staging. Finally, I got a phish-sim notice but no follow-up emails. Who do I poke for each?

people-ops: Welcome @nina :tada: Tagging IT and security below.

it-support: Hi Nina 1 For the cert error try: 1) open the mobileconfig in Keychain Access and verify the signing cert; 2) if its untrusted, download the CA from https://redwood.example/internal/ca and install it to System keychain then try again. If that doesn't work, paste the exact installer log: `log show --predicate 'subsystem CONTAINS "mdm"' --last 1h | tail -n 80`.

security: FileVault is required if you will store production secrets or access prod infra locally. For staging-only BYOD we accept the signed BYOD attestation and can grant limited dev tokens. Phish-sim is mandatory; emails come from training@phishsim.io (subject "Redwood Security Training"). If you didn't get the reminders, check spam and DM me and I'll re-enroll you.

nina: Thanks 1 I installed the CA and enrollment progressed past the cert step but now fails at 'Applying restrictions'. Screenshot: "MDM: Failed to apply restrictions - policy mismatch". Also I submitted the BYOD form and selected staging-only.

it-support: Policy mismatch usually means an old profile is present. Run `sudo profiles -P` and if you see an old redwood profile remove it with `sudo profiles -R -p <profile-id>`. Then re-run the installer. If the error persists, we can run a remote session.

security-bot: Reminder: Complete SEC101 security training within 8 days: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/sec101. Phish-sim FAQ: https://redwood.example/internal/phishsim-faq.

people-ops: Let us know if you want a company laptop instead of BYOD. Welcome again!
